<!--
Before submitting, check the source branch and PR title against CONTRIBUTING.md.
Example: branch cicd/check-pr-names, title "ci: Check Gitflow branch names and PR titles".
Keep the four headings below and replace the prompts with evidence. A small change can use one sentence per section.
Review pasted text and attachments for credentials, private URLs, and customer data.
-->

## Problem and impact

<!-- State the observed problem or user need, what changes, and who or what is affected. Link the issue or accepted design if one exists. Use `Closes #123` only when a PR to the default branch fully resolves the issue. Disclose substantive AI assistance when used. -->

## Validation

<!-- Name the command or manual steps, environment, tested commit or worktree baseline, and actual result. Link completed CI runs where relevant. For a check you could not run, name the check and explain what prevented it. -->

## Screenshots and interaction

<!-- For visual changes, attach comparable runtime screenshots and identify the page or state. For interaction changes, describe the action and observed result or link a recording. For other changes, explain briefly why there is no visual or interaction impact. -->

## Compatibility and unverified scope

<!-- Describe effects on APIs, configuration, data, or upgrades, and list any relevant platform, deployment, or check that remains unverified. A brief explanation is enough for an unaffected scope. -->
